summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly progress on its €1.0 billion share buyback programme announced on 30 April 2026. During 8-12 June 2026, 1,750,000 shares were repurchased at an average price of €25.46 (total €44.6M). Cumulative repurchases total 10,700,000 shares at an average €25.67, representing ~27.47% of the programme's maximum value. The buyback is part of a capital return initiative to reduce share capital. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The programme is ongoing with weekly updates disclosed. Watch for pace of repurchases and potential completion date vs. the announced total.
